test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 are five men sitting in a line facing towards the south. L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5 are five women sitting in a second line, parellel to the first line, facing towards the north.

M2, who is to the immediate left of M4, is opposite L5.

M3 and L2 are diagonally opposite each other.

M5 is opposite L3, who is to the immediate right of L1.

L4, who is to the immediate right of L3, is opposite M4.

L1 is at one end of the line.

Which of the following pair is diagonally opposite each other?
solution:
**Explanation:**

1st Line → M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 are five men sitting in a line facing towards the south

2nd Line→ L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5 are five women sitting in a second line, parellel to the first line, facing towards the north. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a16f79bd01820a009e45d4a3c6f0d6e27241e1435bc64187bac70d59482aa38c.png] 

 
• L1 is at one end of the line. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fe6158986d7dfdc28115ca54261fee598842337b0aa1b4a8ad03142e961f1c5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3164100be83a4c804deb931a49fd41bb351a406d2713a97629fa111ebff3398.png] 

 
• **M5** is opposite **L3**, who is to the **immediate right of L1**.**(Case 2 gets cancelled)**
 
• **L4**, who is to the **immediate right of L3**, is **opposite M4.** [Precaution: L4 is opposite M4] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8803c080f44b38a0b9ae81e76641705652b24b79fa56cad762349a9636f4dcd9.png] 
 
• **M2**, who is to the **immediate left** of **M4**, is **opposite** **L5.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42cef10c93da185e70a13c02c688cdec86651c10875b34b78d91ff1590fff708.png] 
 
• **M3** and **L2** are **diagonally opposite** each other. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ab9898ba2ae46424b7f5e8cc8d71598254237d75ba444f0b2e28a046dff0e6.png] 

According, to the arrangements **M1 and L1** are **diagonally opposite to each other**.

**Hence, the correct answer is M1 and L1.**
